decisions.rationale: Standalone MA supplies without in the quoted condition. No English negative stem is invented.
NOR is the noun mistake, distinct from the later verbal mistaken.

The intended victim LHA SBYIN is localized as the first John in the explicit example. There is no exact LHA SBYIN master entry; local source syntax plus the later369 example supports the name correspondence provisionally. The second English John is an explanatory repetition, not a second source name.
The whole exemplifying formula LTA BU owns for example. Do not include the following case framing.
GSOD PA is the intended killing, selecting the first of the two kill occurrences.
SBYOR BA directly attests undertake and is the preparation term here. BYAS is support in the same predicate, not a second claimant on undertake.
This later NOR is the mistaken-identity verb, directly attested as mistaken; it is separate from the initial mistake noun.

The second MCHOD SBYIN is the explicit killed object, localized as Joe. The first occurrence participates in the mistake clause and is pronominally recast; it is unbanked. The full master auto-mined John gloss conflicts with this local object and is not followed; reference Yajñadatta and later369 provide context, not a replacement for GMR Joe.
BSAD is the actual killing of Joe, distinct from GSOD PA/kill John; preserve the source tense/spelling with GMR present kill.
The first technical action-path term is rendered act in this prose. Whole LAS LAM remains a provisional local correspondence; no degenerate LAS/act member is possible.

The whole technical main-stage term directly attests actual- commission. Keep the exact physical line-wrap-derived space after the hyphen; leave the explanatory stage outside this tight attested expression.
The whole actual member ends at the printed hyphen and is strictly inside the technical compound. The unrelated mined GZHI/give it a name gloss supplies no commission member.
Standalone MI negates the first occurrence predicate and owns the first no.
The first explicit BYUNG occurrence supplies occurs; this is the mistaken-identity case.
The first BSTAN governs the quoted without-a-mistake explanation and the first indicate.
The quoted GZHAN explicitly supplies another in the second explanation.
RANG supplies own in the self-killing paraphrase. His is supplied possession framing; the killing word has no separate lexical kill exponent here.
Standalone LA marks this instance of self-killing, rendered in. It is not assigned to the earlier mistaken-identity case.
The second technical compound maps the second quoted actual-commission, whose printed hyphen has no intervening space. Stage remains explanatory as in the first occurrence.
Second explicit actual member is unique and strict inside its second compound. No cross-occurrence range or ungrounded GZHI/commission member.
Second MI owns the second no in the self-killing explanation.
Second explicit occurrence verb owns the second occurs; the additional either is not assigned to the earlier KYANG.
Second BSTAN owns second indicate. Final closure TO and expanded explanatory framing remain unwrapped.
